title: LISD Trustees Veronica Orduno and Goyo Lopez Sworn In After Re-Election
excerpt: Laredo Independent School District Board Members Veronica Orduno and Goyo Lopez were officially sworn in as members of the LISD Board of Trustees on Monday, Nov
content:
Laredo Independent School District Board Members Veronica Orduno and Goyo Lopez were officially sworn in as members of the LISD Board of Trustees on Monday, Nov. 17, according to Laredo ISD.

Orduno represents District 3 and Lopez represents District 5. Both were re-elected to office and took their oath of office together, according to the district.

Administering the oath was U.S. District Judge Diana Saldaña of the Southern District of Texas, according to Laredo ISD.

Source: Laredo Independent School District, Nov. 17, 2026.
